lines.speaker: pip_ashdown
lines.text: Annet was a guard. She had a whistle, a proper one. I think it is by her stone. Would you look? I do not want somebody treading on it.
lines.direction: Bright, quick child voice; curious and earnest, small pauses when something hurts.

options.label: We will look at Annet's grave.

lines.speaker: pip_ashdown
lines.text: Thank you. Do not make it into a dare. It is her place.
lines.direction: Bright, quick child voice; curious and earnest, small pauses when something hurts.

lines.speaker: pip_ashdown
lines.text: Annet's stone, near the other graves. You will know it.
lines.direction: Bright, quick child voice; curious and earnest, small pauses when something hurts.

lines.speaker: pip_ashdown
lines.text: You found it. May I hold it? I will not blow it here.
lines.direction: Bright, quick child voice; curious and earnest, small pauses when something hurts.

lines.speaker: pip_ashdown
lines.text: It is heavier than I thought. I will take it back when I visit her. Promise.
lines.direction: Bright, quick child voice; curious and earnest, small pauses when something hurts.

lines.speaker: pip_ashdown
lines.text: You left it with her? Good. I could come with you next time. Just to sit a little.
lines.direction: Bright, quick child voice; curious and earnest, small pauses when something hurts.

lines.speaker: pip_ashdown
lines.text: I know where it belongs now. Thank you for being careful.
lines.direction: Bright, quick child voice; curious and earnest, small pauses when something hurts.

lines.speaker: pip_ashdown
lines.text: Mind the puddles. The deep one looks just like the others.
lines.direction: Bright, quick child voice; curious and earnest, small pauses when something hurts.
